submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on the token that closes a syntactic slot opened by the immediately preceding words (typically within ~4 tokens): a determiner or complement after a preposition (over the, on the, by Friday), the particle after an auxiliary (did not), the second half of a fixed collocation (ORDER BY), a unit/date noun after a numeral or temporal anchor (three days of, next/last year, in March, eight characters), the finite main verb after its subject (market fell, violinist played, orchestra tuned), or sentence-final punctuation closing the clause. The same surface token fires weakly or not at all when it does not close such a slot (e.g. 'the' after a verb, 'of' after 'ideas', 'year' replaced by 'idea').

adversarial_test_results.prompt: loudly praising the
adversarial_test_results.detail: Hypothesis predicts 'the' fires only closing a preposition-opened slot, so 'the' after the verb 'praising' with no preposition should be inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: bright ideas of
adversarial_test_results.detail: Hypothesis predicts 'of' fires closing a numeral-anchored slot like 'three days of', so 'of' after plain 'ideas' with no numeral should be inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: already October — that idea
adversarial_test_results.detail: Hypothesis explicitly predicts replacing 'year' with 'idea' kills activation, so this fragment ending in 'idea' with no numeral anchor should be inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: long memo approved BY
adversarial_test_results.detail: Hypothesis predicts uppercase BY fires as the second half of ORDER BY, so BY after 'approved' with no ORDER/GROUP opener should be inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: definitely or definitely not
adversarial_test_results.detail: Hypothesis predicts 'not' fires as the particle after an auxiliary, so sentence-free 'not' preceded only by an adverb should be inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: dark dismal fell
adversarial_test_results.detail: Hypothesis predicts 'fell' fires as a finite verb after its subject, so 'fell' as a noun meaning hill after adjectives should be inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Friday
adversarial_test_results.detail: Hypothesis predicts date nouns fire closing a temporal-anchor slot, so bare 'Friday' with no preceding opener and nothing to close should be inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Dr. Smith
adversarial_test_results.detail: Hypothesis predicts sentence-final periods closing a clause fire, so the abbreviation period in 'Dr.' mid-fragment with no clause close should be inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: three very very very very hungry
adversarial_test_results.detail: Hypothesis limits the retrospective slot to ~4 tokens and to unit nouns, so an adjective five tokens past 'three' should be inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: big red A
adversarial_test_results.detail: Hypothesis predicts 'a' fires closing a slot, so capital A as a named letter after adjectives with no opener should be inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Level
adversarial_test_results.detail: Hypothesis predicts 'level' fires as a slot-closing noun, so bare imperative 'Level' opening with no preceding slot should be inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The parcel slid under the door during lunch
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel preposition-complement slot with fresh vocabulary: 'the' directly closes the slot opened by 'under', so the hypothesis predicts firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: They had never visited Rome before
adversarial_test_results.detail: Paraphrase of the auxiliary-particle slot using 'never' instead of the trigger 'not', so the hypothesis predicts firing without any claimed surface token.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: DELETE FROM orders WHERE status expired GROUP BY customer
adversarial_test_results.detail: Cross-genre SQL holdout with a new collocation: BY closes the GROUP-opened slot just as in ORDER BY, so the hypothesis predicts firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: drought lasted seven winters without relief
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel numeral-unit slot with unseen words: 'winters' closes the slot opened by 'seven', so the hypothesis predicts firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Captain's log, stardate 4417: the reactor crew worked through the night shift while radiation alarms echoed across every deck, and by dawn the engineers finally sealed the leaking core.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Cross-genre holdout in a new domain with fresh subject-verb pairs and a clause-closing final period, both of which the hypothesis predicts should fire.
